tasks_completed.description: Changed recovery restore from external process spawning to daemon-owned /spawn-session with /list verification before counting as restored.
tasks_completed.changes: Recovery now posts directory/agent/resumeSessionId to the running daemon control server, verifies the returned Happy session appears in daemon /list, increments daemon_tracked_restored only after that proof, and reports failed rather than externally restored when daemon ownership cannot be proven.
tasks_completed.rationale: QA OBJ-1 identified external systemd/direct spawn plus daemon_tracked_restored=0 as the remaining root blocker. The daemon now owns recovery spawn/adoption through its existing tracking map instead of recovery overclaiming an external process.

tasks_completed.description: Wired durable recovery tombstone creation into manual stop and archive paths.
tasks_completed.changes: Added recordSessionRecoveryTombstone() using the same per-home TSV file recovery already respects; daemon stop-session records resume/Claude/Codex/Happy IDs before termination; Claude and Codex manual archive cleanup record resume/current/Happy IDs before lifecycleState=archived.
tasks_completed.rationale: QA OBJ-2 identified tombstone consumers without normal producers. Manual user intent is now durably recorded at the stop/archive action point.

tasks_completed.description: Performed safe static and targeted package verification only.
tasks_completed.changes: Ran bash syntax, TypeScript type-check, control server unit test, and static greps. No reboot, service stop/restart, daemon HTTP stop, kill, or live session manipulation was performed.
tasks_completed.rationale: Matches user constraints and QA acceptance that this can be verified without killing live sessions.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A - iteration 2 resolves QA blocking objections from docs/dev/qa-report-20260523-235421.json
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Iteration 1 added truthful reporting and tombstone storage, but recovery still launched sessions outside daemon ownership and normal stop/archive paths did not create tombstones.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Recovery now uses the daemon control spawn path and verifies daemon /list membership before success; manual stop/archive paths write the durable tombstone file recovery already filters.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: The fix crosses a host recovery script plus daemon control API and three manual lifecycle entry points. Git diff stats are from git diff --stat HEAD and exclude /root/bin/happy-session-recovery.sh because it is outside the repository. Some controlClient/run.ts changes were already present before this iteration and were preserved.

No live services/sessions were stopped, restarted, rebooted, or killed.
